notes.title: Update for January 2025!
notes.content:
Hello!

Here's the update for January 2025! This update focuses on the CORRUPTION path of the game where our protagonists chose to join the shady organization. You can now clearly see how the paths will diverge in the game. Besides the usual story content we added further improvements to the game which we will list in the changelog below. Enjoy this update and we'll see you again when we release the next update in late March! The update we will release in March will focus on the LOVE path where our heroes have refused the offer to join the mysterious organization.

[b]Changelog:
214 new renders
7 new animations
Reworked the Gallery. The Gallery can now be accessed from the main menu instead of being in-game. Also, an option to unlock the scenes you're missing has been added. (You might need to restart the game after using the unlock feature for the scenes to unlock.)[/b]

notes.title: Update for May 2024!
notes.content:
Hello!

We have just released the update for May 2024!
This update marks the first major update release on Steam so make sure to tell us what you think.
The biggest change to this update is the Gallery. Our players have asked for a Gallery from the beginning and now we have added one. In regards to story content, this update sadly wasn't as big as we wanted. We went through a big adjustment period, adding the Gallery which was a ton of work, as well as hiring a new writer. However, this means that the heavy stuff is out of the way and now we can focus on the story content.
[b]Also, we need to let you know that there was a TON of changes to the code in this update so old saves may not work or crash the game. We HIGHLY recommend starting a new game (since that will also allow you to unlock scenes for the gallery).[/b]
There you go, we will now get back to work on the update which will be released in August!

Changelog for this version:
Added a Gallery (You access the Gallery in-game with the icon on the upper left corner of the screen)
320 Renders
9 Animations

notes.title: Hotfix update coming out tomorrow!
notes.content:
Hello!

We wanted to inform you guys about a quick little update that we should release tomorrow.

[b]First Feature - Music[/b]

We will be adding Music to our game! We got everything sorted out and we can start having music in the game. We have added a bunch of tracks and we hope you will enjoy them!

[b]Second Feature - More Clear Paths[/b]

This is more of a Quality of Life feature. We noticed from our achievements that only a few of you chose the "Love" path in the game. We didn't know whether that was because the majority of you didn't want it or maybe just missed it, thinking that the corruption path was the only 'viable' one.
That's why we added a disclaimer as well as a pink color to all choices in the "Love" path.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857390/00b3b921926a786168508bf83c636e0c5d4ffd3c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857390/b643e11cd4120da83b2a068e1d905e2a35c113c8.png[/img]

[b]Third Feature - New Content[/b]

This one is quite simple. We've been working on the future update and we decided to include that content in this update as a small thank you for the amazing support. Obviously the content will be very short since we didn't have a ton of time to work on it but we still think you will enjoy it!
